desc: Coldrage Dagger: Amnennar the Coldbringer's dagger from World of Warcraft: a pale icy blue frost dagger
Rod of the Ogre Magi: the Gordok tribute's staff from World of Warcraft: a big ogre magi staff
Thermaplugg's Left Arm: Mekgineer Thermaplugg's two-handed axe from World of Warcraft: a mechanical gnome arm ending in an axe blade
Hand of Righteousness: High Inquisitor Whitemane's mace from World of Warcraft: a holy golden mace
Moonleaf Staff: a druid's staff of pale moonwood, a crescent of silver leaves at the top glowing softly
Wild King's Bough: a huge gnarled oak branch used as a club, mossy, with new green leaves sprouting from it
Misha: Rexxar's big brown bear companion, made small: a fluffy brown bear cub sitting on the shoulder, looking fierce
Ship's Wheel: a polished wooden yacht wheel with brass caps on the spokes
Pair of Skis: a pair of old wooden skis with red bindings, carried over the shoulder
Dragonbone Driver: a golf driver with a shaft of dragon bone and a head like a small black dragon skull, embers glowing in its eyes
Tennis Sweatband: a white towelling sweatband round the head with a thin green stripe
Members' Crested Cap: a navy wool cap with a gold-embroidered club crest and a short stiff peak
Fishing Waders: green rubber chest waders with braces over a checked flannel shirt, lures hooked on the bib
Polo Jersey: a fitted dark green polo shirt with a big white number 4, white jodhpurs and brown knee pads
Muddy Dungarees: baggy denim dungarees caked in swamp mud, one strap undone, a frog peeking out of the front pocket
Crown of Coals: a crown of glowing red-hot coals, little flames flickering between them
Phoenix Feather Cloak: a cloak of red, orange and gold phoenix feathers, the edges glowing like embers
Gold Puffer Jacket: a big tacky shiny gold puffer jacket, fat quilted panels, a gold zip and fake fur on the hood edge
Gold Cap: a shiny gold baseball cap worn slightly sideways, the sticker still on the flat brim
Fistful of Gold: a fat fistful of gold coins, a few spilling out between the fingers
Fishing Net: a bundled-up old fishing net of knotted brown rope with round cork floats along the edge and a little starfish caught in it
Sheep Nightcap: a fluffy white woolly nightcap shaped like a sleepy sheep head, two little floppy black ears, a tiny pom-pom on top; it sits on the head, above the brow, and the face is fully visible
Sheep Onesie: a big puffy cuddly sheep onesie of thick curly white wool, black felt hooves at the cuffs, a little round tail; closed down the front; just the body suit, no hood
